Main characters: Surya (unemployed engineering graduate), Meghana (sister), Lakshmi (mother), Father, Swami (friend), Shiva (friend), and Anjali (girlfriend). The episode revolves around Surya's birthday, balancing comic slice-of-life banter among unemployed friends, an absurd delivery guy sketch, and the underlying emotional pressure from his father to find a job.

moment_table.why: When the mother asks the father to bless Surya on his birthday, he delivers a typical middle-class dad roast by telling him to finally get a job after three years of engineering.
After Surya boasts about throwing a lavish birthday celebration for Meghana with a giant tent and AR Rahman songs, Meghana cuts him down to size by reminding him it is a birthday, not a wedding.

moment_table.text: అయ్యి మీ నాన్న ఇచ్చినవేరా, ఆయన ఇస్తే నువ్వు తీసుకోవని నాకిచ్చేల్లారు.
moment_table.why: Surya takes money from the pooja room thinking he escaped his strict father's scrutiny, only for his mother to reveal that his father secretly left the money there for him.

moment_table.text: అంత ముందు చూపు ఉంటే జాబ్ ఎందుకు కొట్టలేదా మూడేళ్ల నుంచి.
moment_table.why: When Swami pompously claims that pre-packing grocery items at their store is his foresight, his father instantly roasts him by asking why that foresight did not get him a job in three years.
When asked to manage the cash counter at his father's store, Swami excuses himself with the absurd punchline that engineers should never stay in one place as it is bad for the country.

moment_table.text: ఇంజనీరింగ్ అయిపోయిన తర్వాత మనకున్న ఒకే ఒక పెద్ద పండగ మనకు job వచ్చిన రోజు.
moment_table.why: Surya delivers a relatable monologue to his friends about unemployed life, declaring that for an engineering graduate, the only real festival is the day they finally get a job.

moment_table.text: నువ్వు ఇవ్వాలిరా నాకు five star rating.
moment_table.why: After entering the house, eating Shiva's dosa, drinking water, and taking a cigarette, the delivery boy asks for a five-star rating, prompting Shiva to shout that the delivery boy should be rating him instead.

moment_table.text: ఆహ్ అందుకే మా నాన్న మీతో friendship చేయొద్దనేది.
moment_table.why: Surya tries to romanticize wasting hours together as the true meaning of friendship, but Swami deadpans that this aimless loafing is the exact reason his father told him to avoid them.

moment_table.text: అందరం కలిసి కూర్చుని భోంచేసి ఎన్నో రోజులైందో.
moment_table.why: Despite his stern lectures, the father refuses to eat dinner early and insists on waiting hungry so the entire family can sit and eat together on Surya's birthday.
Surya arrives home heavily intoxicated shouting slurred declarations of love to his family, abruptly freezing the room as his strict father walks in and coldly asks if he came home drunk.
After collapsing into bed drunk having disappointed his family, Surya mutters a heartbreaking, slurred promise to himself that he will definitely land a job.
